context: A police officer briefs an exec about local cooperation
purpose: Teach: 地盤/町長/奨学/実名/前編/メーター/パッチ/ならびに

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の地盤強化、町長からも、感謝の声が届いています。
lines.en: Your company's foundation-strengthening efforts have earned the mayor's appreciation. We've heard good things.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Even tone, steady eye contact. Formal but not cold — the warmth of official recognition. A slight pause before the second sentence, letting weight settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元の奨学金、実名で報じられて、評判です。
lines.en: Yes. The local scholarship received named media coverage. It's been well-received.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Responds directly without overstepping. Calm certainty — he knows this is good work. Slight lean-in to show genuine agreement, not just protocol.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今後の防犯講習、前編と後編、二回に分けます。
lines.en: Going forward, we'll split the safety workshops into two sessions — a first part and a follow-up.
lines.style: Clear, informative delivery. Deliberate pacing on each phrase. No rush — he's laying out a plan that matters. Professional tone with an underlying care for thorough implementation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。メーター監視、ならびにパッチ更新、警察と歩調を合わせます。
lines.en: Understood. We'll keep meter monitoring and patch updates synchronized with your department.
lines.style: Committed, assured. Direct acknowledgment followed by concrete commitment. Steady voice showing readiness to move in lockstep. No hesitation, just reliable agreement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.en: Thank you. We'll be counting on you.
lines.style: Quiet closing. A slight nod in the voice. Formal but genuine — the finality of mutual respect between people who understand accountability. Gentle exhale at the end.
